facts.fact: Lei 6/15 makes the ministerial department responsible for the justice sector the body responsible for the civil registry database (art. 15), into whose national computer record every civil registry act must be entered (art. 13).
facts.system: base de dados do registo civil

systems.system: base de dados do registo civil
systems.country_label: base de dados do registo civil; suporte informático do registo civil nacional
systems.owner: the ministerial department responsible for the justice sector
systems.tiers: by law, all civil registry acts: entries are drawn up at conservatórias, civil registry posts, health units and, where no service exists, by mobile civil registry means; consular entries go into it 'when conditions permit'. The law states a requirement and does not say which offices comply

systems.country_label: envio dos dados sobre o nascimento à Conservatória do Registo Civil
systems.tiers: by law, every health unit sends birth data to the conservatória of its area within 72 hours, electronically 'whenever possible' (art. 4)

systems.system: communication of birth data to social, health and tax services
systems.tiers: by law, on each birth entry, to social assistance, social security and health services and, on request, the tax services, electronically 'whenever possible' (art. 10)

systems.system: interconnection of the civil registry and civil identification databases
systems.country_label: interconexão com a base de dados da identificação civil
systems.owner: the ministerial department responsible for the justice sector
systems.tiers: permitted by law (art. 14): an update in the civil registry database is to update the identity database automatically; checking the registry database replaces the birth certificate for issuing an identity card (art. 13)

systems.system: Programa de Massificação do Registo Civil
systems.country_label: Programa de Massificação do Registo Civil
systems.tiers: named in the preamble as the programme to register all citizens and issue their first identity card wherever they live

note: A law, so what it states is a requirement and not practice: civil registry acts are 'obrigatoriamente integrados em suporte informático do registo civil nacional' and proved by access to the database (art. 13), and face, iris, fingerprint and signature are collected for automated processing at the act of registration (art. 16). No fact is recorded on events, how the record is made or offices, because the law does not say that any office registers digitally; the parent may wish to weigh the legal requirement.
